alternatives: and in the book of the kings
decisions.reason: The vision may be described as found within the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel, or the two may be named as separate sources.

decisions.choice: faithful deeds (Literal, Balanced); faithful things he did (Readable)
decisions.reason: The usual "steadfast love" or "faithful love" fits God's love better than a list of a king's deeds, so these words name the deeds. The same wording is used for Josiah at 35:26.

decisions.choice: "look" left out; the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel (Balanced); the book of the kings of Judah and Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 16:11 and 27:7.

decisions.choice: "sus obras de fidelidad" (L, B); "las cosas que hizo con fidelidad" (R)
decisions.reason: The word for loyal love is said of a king's deeds here, so Spanish speaks of faithful deeds, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "신실한 행위들" (Literal), "신실한 일들" (Balanced, Readable) for the plural of *ḥesed*
decisions.reason: As the English does, the deeds are named by what they were, loyal acts for God (m2); the same words are used for Josiah at 35:26. "묵시" renders "vision", as Isaiah 1:1 calls the book.

decisions.choice: os seus atos de fidelidade (L, B); o restante (L), os demais atos (B), tudo o mais (R); o livro dos reis de Judá e de Israel (L, R), o Livro dos Reis de Judá e de Israel (B)
alternatives: os seus atos de amor leal
decisions.reason: The source formula keeps the wording 16:11 and 27:7 set in Portuguese at each level, with "eis que" at Literal. The king's acts of *chesed* toward God (m2) are "atos de fidelidade", as the English "faithful deeds": "amor leal" is kept for God's own love.

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Hezekiah with his fathers, and they buried him in [the] ascent of [the] tombs of [the] sons of David, and honor they did to him at his death, all Judah and [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem. And reigned Manasseh his son in his place.

en.L: And Hezekiah lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the ascent of the tombs of the sons of David, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honor at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Then Hezekiah rested with his ancestors, and they buried him on the ascent to the tombs of David's descendants. All Judah and the people of Jerusalem honored him at his death. His son Manasseh became king in his place.
en.R: Then Hezekiah died and was buried on the slope where the tombs of David's descendants are. All the people of Judah and Jerusalem honored him when he died. His son Manasseh became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Ezequías con sus padres, y lo sepultaron en la subida de los sepulcros de los hijos de David, y le hicieron honra a su muerte todo Judá y los habitantes de Jerusalén. Y reinó en su lugar Manasés su hijo.
es.B: Luego Ezequías descansó con sus antepasados, y lo sepultaron en la subida de los sepulcros de los descendientes de David. Todo Judá y los habitantes de Jerusalén lo honraron en su muerte. Su hijo Manasés reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Luego Ezequías murió y fue sepultado en la ladera donde están los sepulcros de los descendientes de David. Toda la gente de Judá y de Jerusalén lo honró cuando murió. Su hijo Manasés lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias se coucha avec ses pères, et on l’enterra à la montée des tombeaux des fils de David ; et tout Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem lui rendirent honneur à sa mort. Et Manassé son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Puis Ézéchias reposa avec ses ancêtres, et on l’enterra à la montée des tombeaux des descendants de David. Tout Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem l’honorèrent à sa mort. Son fils Manassé régna à sa place.
fr.R: Ensuite Ézéchias est mort. On l’a enterré sur la pente où se trouvent les tombeaux des descendants de David. Tous les gens de Juda et de Jérusalem l’ont honoré à sa mort. Son fils Manassé est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Naye Hezekia akalala pamoja na baba zake, wakamzika katika mwinuko wa makaburi ya wana wa Daudi, na Yuda wote na wakaaji wa Yerusalemu wakamfanyia heshima katika kifo chake. Na Manase mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha Hezekia akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, wakamzika katika mwinuko unaoelekea makaburi ya wazao wa Daudi. Yuda wote na watu wa Yerusalemu walimheshimu alipokufa. Na mwanawe Manase akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha Hezekia akafa, akazikwa katika mteremko yalipo makaburi ya wazao wa Daudi. Watu wote wa Yuda na Yerusalemu walimheshimu alipokufa. Na mwanawe Manase akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và người ta chôn vua ở dốc lên các lăng mộ của con cháu Đa-vít; cả Giu-đa và dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem tôn vinh vua khi vua qua đời. Ma-na-se con trai vua trị vì thay vua.
vi.B: Rồi Ê-xê-chia an giấc cùng tổ tiên, và người ta chôn vua ở dốc lên các lăng mộ của dòng dõi Đa-vít. Cả Giu-đa và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem đều tôn vinh vua khi vua qua đời. Ma-na-se con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Rồi Ê-xê-chia qua đời và được chôn trên sườn đồi nơi có lăng mộ của dòng dõi Đa-vít. Toàn dân Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem đều tôn vinh vua khi vua qua đời. Ma-na-se con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 사람들이 그를 다윗 자손의 묘실들로 올라가는 비탈에 묻었다. 그리고 온 유다와 예루살렘 주민들이 그가 죽을 때에 그에게 영예를 돌렸다. 그리고 그의 아들 므낫세가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 히스기야는 조상들과 함께 잠들었다. 사람들은 그를 다윗 자손의 묘실들로 올라가는 비탈에 묻었다. 온 유다와 예루살렘 주민들이 그의 죽음을 맞아 그에게 영예를 돌렸다. 그의 아들 므낫세가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 히스기야는 죽었다. 그는 다윗 자손의 무덤들이 있는 언덕 비탈에 묻혔다. 유다와 예루살렘의 모든 백성이 그가 죽었을 때에 그를 높이 기렸다. 그의 아들 므낫세가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Ezequias descansou com os seus pais, e o sepultaram na subida dos túmulos dos filhos de Davi; e todo o Judá e os habitantes de Jerusalém lhe prestaram honra na sua morte. E Manassés, o seu filho, reinou no seu lugar.
pt.B: Então Ezequias descansou com os seus antepassados, e o sepultaram na subida que leva aos túmulos dos descendentes de Davi. Todo o Judá e o povo de Jerusalém o honraram na sua morte. E o seu filho Manassés se tornou rei no seu lugar.
pt.R: Então Ezequias morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados. Ele foi sepultado na encosta onde ficam os túmulos dos descendentes de Davi. Todo o povo de Judá e de Jerusalém o honrou quando ele morreu. O seu filho Manassés se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The usual way the books of Kings and Chronicles speak of a king's death.

decisions.choice: the ascent of the tombs of the sons of David: a place of honor among the royal tombs
alternatives: the upper part of the tombs
decisions.reason: *Ma'aleh* is a slope or rise, and may mean the upper part of the burial ground. Either way the burial place itself honored him.

decisions.choice: honor at his death; Manasseh reigned: 2 Kings 20:21
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 20:21 says only that he lay down with his fathers and Manasseh reigned. Chronicles adds the burial and the honor the people gave him.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula, worded as in 2 Kings 20:21 and 2 Chronicles 27:9.

decisions.choice: descansou com os seus pais (L), com os seus antepassados (B), morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados (R); Manassés ... reinou (L), se tornou rei (B, R)
decisions.reason: The death formula keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 20:21 at each level (m1, m3), with Readable's "morreu e foi descansar" as there and as 27:9; the burial and the honour are Chronicles' own, drafted from its Hebrew.
